dedupeText: late 80s hip hop album aesthetic 80s hip hop graffiti style neon airbrush urban studio 3d block lettering pop rap aesthetic subject to background contrast via hard studio lighting juxtaposition of neutral grey apparel against neon pink and yellow graphic elements diagonal typographic flow balancing the verticality of the subjects combine urban studio photography with airbrushed neon graphics and 3d comic typography to recreate the late 80s pop rap aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of two figures in urban fashion set against a textured, airbrushed background featuring vibrant neon accents and bold, 3D comic-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via hard studio lighting
Juxtaposition of neutral grey apparel against neon pink and yellow graphic elements
Diagonal typographic flow balancing the verticality of the subjects
coreInvariants: Airbrushed 'glow' effects around text and background edges
Hard shadows cast against a flat studio wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the left two-thirds of the frame, full-body and mid-shot respectively.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, 3D extruded title text in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down their poses to the bright pink props at their feet, then sweeps up through the diagonal title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark vignetting on the right side provides a canvas for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted grey and black (apparel and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink and bright yellow (props and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements against low saturation subjects to create a 'pop' effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid modern digital gradients; use speckled airbrush transitions.

letterConstructionRules: Letters must have a thick black outline
3D depth is achieved through a downward-right extrusion in a contrasting color
Internal color gradients from yellow to pink
Small white 'sparkle' or 'glint' icons on corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point is oversized and tilted
Letters are staggered in height to create a rhythmic, bouncy baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy illustrated display type paired with a stable, authoritative slab serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, rounded skeleton for the display text.
Matches the blocky slab serif secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photo of two women in 1980s hip-hop fashion (grey sweatsuits, black hats, gloves) posing against a dark wall with teal and purple airbrushed spray paint effects. Include neon pink cinder blocks at their feet. Use high-contrast lighting and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D block lettering in the bottom right corner tilted upwards. The letters should have a yellow-to-pink gradient, thick black outlines, and a deep pink 3D extrusion. Add a secondary slab-serif name in the top right with a soft outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D extrusion consistent across all letters?
Does the background have a visible airbrushed texture?
Are the neon accents (pink/yellow) the brightest points in the image?
Is the film grain visible but not obscuring details?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any unique brand logos on the clothing
Exact letter shapes of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the text is legible despite the 3D effect.
Ensure the lighting on the subjects matches the shadows on the wall.
Check that the neon colors do not bleed excessively into the subjects.
Verify the composition feels bottom-heavy and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Studio Photography] with [Airbrushed Neon Graphics] and [3D Comic Typography] to recreate the [Late 80s Pop-Rap] aesthetic.
